confidence_notes: Kampot crowd-sourced data last updated in May 2026 supports the meal, beer and cappuccino estimates, but covers 34 entries from only four contributors. comparable_city_reasoning: Kampot’s smaller inland tourism market suggests basic rooms and three-star hotels near, but somewhat above, Siem Reap and Phnom Penh; hostel prices are closer to Siem Reap and Sihanoukville than to higher-priced El Nido.
